directions: Suppose you are going to write a proposal to your school clinic for improving its service. You are to write about its current problems and possible solutions to these problems. You will have 30 minutes to write the proposal. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
I am writing this proposal to suggest some improvements to the school clinic's service. Currently, there are several issues that need to be addressed.

To begin with, the waiting time in the clinic is often too long. Many students have to wait for hours to see a doctor, which is extremely inconvenient, especially when they are not feeling well. For example, last week I had a fever and had to wait for more than two hours. In addition, the variety of medicine available in the clinic is limited. Some common medicines are often out of stock, forcing students to go outside the school to buy them.

To solve these problems, I suggest that the clinic hire more medical staff to reduce the waiting time. Moreover, the clinic should improve its inventory management to ensure a sufficient supply of common medicines. 

In conclusion, by implementing these suggestions, the school clinic can provide better service to students and meet their medical needs more effectively.
